# Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Center, Aarhus Universitetshospital

Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Center, Aarhus Universitetshospital is a psychiatric center in the Danish region of Region Midtjylland, mentioned in the corpus only as the affiliated institution of clinical psychologist Anne-Mette Lange [^src1]. The center appears in the appendices of a report on the ADHD database (ADHD_2024.pdf), a document that documents the members of a steering group for the ADHD database along with detailed data on the database population for the period 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025 [^src1]. That steering group draws representatives from all five Danish regions, professional societies, patient organizations, and the Danish Healthcare Quality Programme (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut) [^src1]. The center's role in the source material is limited to this single institutional affiliation; no further details about its activities, history, or organizational structure are given in the corpus.
